messages:
maya: FYI — I spotted negative cache-credit values in the cost dashboard for tenant acct_zephyr during a burst. Screenshot: https://redwood.prod/snap/abc123 :eyes: Looks like prefetch slab splitting + sampling is double-dipping. Anyone seen this?

sam: Can you paste the query timeframe and tenant id? I'll check the attribution logs.

maya: tenant: acct_zephyr, window: 2026-03-19T14:00Z-14:05Z. I ran the per-invocation breakdown and saw credits = -12.3 in the UI. Raw emits show positive prefetch saves though.

akshay: Most likely cause: when we split a session across slabs we compute slab credits per-slab then apply sampling weights later — bug if sampling is applied after subtracting prefetch, resulting in oversubtraction. quick pseudo: 
```sql
prefetch_credit = prefetch_hits * model_cost
sampled_credit = prefetch_credit * sampling_weight
final_credit = slab_credit - sampled_credit  -- wrong order
```
We should apply sampling weight at slab level before differencing.

jun: UX fix: clamp negative credits to 0 and show tooltip 'adjusted for sampling/latency' while we fix. Otherwise customers see scary negatives. :white_check_mark: 

luis: Agree with akshay. We'll need a reconciliation job to recompute affected windows and backfill dashboard values (not invoices). Also add an alert when >5% of tenants hit negative credits in a rolling 1h. I can own the alert.

sam: I'll make a small repro script and put it in /tmp, then open a tiny PR to reorder the math in attribution service. Can we add a unit test with sampled sessions and slab boundaries?

maya: Yes please. Also UX: add a hover explanation and hide negative graph spikes by default. Jun, can you prototype the clamp + tooltip?

jun: On it. I'll mock in the console and link to a design later. One question: does clamping affect downstream amortized heatmaps?

akshay: Clamping only affects displayed credits; reconciliation/backfill should keep actual internal ledger unchanged until we patch the computation. Heatmaps that use final_credit will reflect clamp if we change source — so prefer display-only clamp for now.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployment started for 'econ-fix-prefetch-sampling' in prod-us-west-2 @channel

luis: cool. sam/akshay, if you push a PR, tag me for the backfill plan. I want the job to run idempotent and emit an affected-tenant list.

sam: will do. PR in ~1h. repro script + core fix + unit tests.

maya: Thanks everyone. I'll add the screenshot and a sample query to the ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INFR-4821

(reacts: :thumbsup: by jun, :eyes: by luis)
